THE DECK REVEALED

TWENTY-SEVEN TORUS FIGURES, DERIVED FROM THE TERNARY CODES
THE WAYFINDER THE MAP ROOM THE RING THE RESONANCE THE INSTRUMENT THE LANGUAGE THE ASTROLABE THE ROSETTE THE SPECTRUM THE WORKSHOP
Twenty-seven golden torus figures, derived from the raw material: the ternary codes under the bijection's own weights (field 9 · relation 3 · core 1). The signed sum is balanced ternary: every integer from −13 to +13 exactly once, so the map is collision-free by theorem, not by choice: the deck is the signed number line, the Seed at zero, the counter-card its negation. No letter appears on this page. The key is in Lonnie's hand; these shapes are committed first.
◯ the circle: the unknot ◠ open coil: winding not yet locked (unknot class) ❂ knot T(p,q): locked, chiral; genus = (p−1)(|q|−1)/2 ⧉ link: g rings, bound (gcd(p,|q|) = g) metals: silver flows (MA) · gold turns (RA) · bronze holds still (AUM) · the Seed white-gold petals = |q|: each card's signed number, visible as its symmetry
